premises.text: Existing blood analyzers cover only a handful of indications and customers cannot afford cost of ownership for the tests they need
premises.evidence_span: These existing blood analyzers can only detect a handful of indications, and most customers can't really pay the cost of ownership in order to cover the tests that they need

premises.text: A tiny phone-connected disposable integrates centrifuge sample prep and spectrophotometry, eliminating the analyzer
premises.evidence_span: eliminating the analyzer altogether. We've done that by integrating into this tiny device, we've integrated the centrifuge, basically the drop of blood sample prep. We've integrated the spectrophotometer, and this also connects to your USB

premises.text: ALT and AST liver enzyme tests complement blood-gas analyzer menus and require spectrophotometric measurement
premises.evidence_span: the reason we're working with ALT and AST is because they complement the existing menus of blood gas analyzers, but they could only be measured spectrophotometrically

premises.text: Emergency veterinary use for rapid anesthesia and drug screens is the first go-to-market
premises.evidence_span: we're launching this into the veterinary space, where emergency veterinarians could use it to run rapid screens for anesthesia or drugs before they admit the patients

premises.text: Modular reagent/filter swaps expand the analyte menu without redesigning the device
premises.evidence_span: If you want to change out the application, you just change the reagents in the filters

premises.text: A single-use disposable model replaces the razor–razor-blade analyzer economics
premises.evidence_span: changing the model from a razor razor blade to a single-use disposable

premises.text: Vertical integration of design and assembly controls manufacturing cost
premises.evidence_span: This is how we control costs. We're vertically integrated. We've designed everything

domains.name: Analyzer coverage and ownership cost problem

value.text: Easier, more affordable blood testing without a traditional analyzer
value.evidence_span: making testing easier and more affordable, not with a universal analyzer, but by eliminating the analyzer altogether
